title: Buster Williams's tone
summary: Rowe names Buster Williams as a favorite bass tone; McBee praises his choice of tones.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Yes indeed. I will paraphrase them for my saxophone students I think, really beautiful. And I wanted to mention, I forgot to mention last time that I now have two favorite tones from bassists. And you are one, and Buster Williams is the other.

Buster Williams. Oh yeah. Buster is an amazing bass player you know. His tonality, he is the exactness if you will, of what I just talked about, his choices of tones, absent of the tones as they blend in with other tones. He’s really somebody that I highly respect.
